'''June 2001 Oxford tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at C&B Cards and Comics, Oxford, North Carolina on 9 June 2001. [[Charles Kerekanich]] won it. It is known from Carson Swanek's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2454">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-14-oxford-north-carolina-9-6-01d2454/ oxford-north-carolina-9-6-01], DeckTech (Carson "tarkinsaide" Swanek, 14 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-14-oxford-north-carolina-9-6-01d2454/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 9 June 2001
* '''Site:''' C&B Cards and Comics, Oxford, North Carolina
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 14
* '''Winner:''' [[Charles Kerekanich]]
